# Infrastructure Kafka Management Standards

This directory contains standards for platform-level Kafka management, operations, and governance from an infrastructure perspective.
page_texts.4:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-001-platform-installation]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-001: Platform Installation

Standards for installing and configuring Kafka management platforms including system requirements, deployment architecture, and initial setup procedures.
page_texts.5:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-002-cluster-registration]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-002: Cluster Registration

Standards for registering Kafka clusters with management platforms including connection configuration, authentication setup, and cluster metadata management.
page_texts.6:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-003-rbac-access-control]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-003: RBAC Access Control

Standards for implementing role-based access control (RBAC) in Kafka management platforms including role definitions, permission models, and access policies.
page_texts.7:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-004-sso-integration]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-004: SSO Integration

Standards for integrating Kafka management platforms with enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) systems including SAML, OIDC, and identity provider configuration.
page_texts.8:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-005-high-availability-deployment]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-005: High Availability Deployment

Standards for deploying Kafka management platforms in highly available configurations including clustering, failover, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
page_texts.9:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-006-event-monitoring]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-006: Event Monitoring

Standards for monitoring Kafka events and message flows including real-time monitoring, historical analysis, and performance metrics.
page_texts.10:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-007-data-lineage]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-007: Data Lineage

Standards for implementing and visualizing data lineage across Kafka topics including lineage tracking, impact analysis, and metadata management.
page_texts.11:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-008-consumer-lag-alerting]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-008: Consumer Lag Alerting

Standards for configuring consumer lag alerts at the infrastructure level including threshold settings, notification channels, and escalation policies.
page_texts.12:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-009-alerting-integration]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-009: Alerting Integration

Standards for integrating Kafka management platform alerts with enterprise alerting systems (PagerDuty, ServiceNow, etc.) including alert routing and deduplication.
page_texts.13:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-010-data-masking]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-010: Data Masking

Standards for implementing data masking in Kafka management platforms to protect sensitive data during inspection and troubleshooting.
page_texts.14:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-011-schema-validation]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-011: Schema Validation

Standards for implementing and enforcing schema validation including schema registry integration, validation rules, and compatibility checks.
page_texts.15:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-012-audit-logging]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-012: Audit Logging

Standards for configuring comprehensive audit logging including access logs, operation logs, configuration changes, and log retention.
page_texts.16:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-013-compliance-reporting]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-013: Compliance Reporting

Standards for generating compliance reports including regulatory requirements, data access reports, and policy adherence metrics.
page_texts.17:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-014-cost-tracking]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-014: Cost Tracking

Standards for tracking and attributing Kafka infrastructure costs including usage metering, chargeback models, and cost optimization recommendations.
page_texts.18:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#std-infra-kmgmt-015-resource-optimization]

### STD-INFRA-KMGMT-015: Resource Optimization

Standards for optimizing Kafka resource utilization including capacity planning, performance tuning, and efficiency improvements.
page_texts.19:
[standards/infrastructure/kafka-management/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Enterprise-ready Kafka management platform deployment
- Secure and compliant Kafka operations
- Comprehensive monitoring and observability
- Operational efficiency and automation
- Cost-effective infrastructure management
